_about: Public-domain George Deshon (1823-1903), West Point graduate turned Paulist priest and Superior General of the Paulists, for the Word Hoard: Guide for Catholic Young Women (1892) and Sermons for all the Sundays of the Ecclesiastical Year (1902). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 91 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

deshon-guide-young-women: Guide for Catholic young women, especially for those who earn their own living (New York : Columbus Pub. Co., 1892)
deshon-sermons: Sermons for all the Sundays of the ecclesiastical year and the principal festivals : for the use of parish priests and for private reading (New York : Catholic Book Exchange, 1902)
